what: P(VT) against VF, for a window ShockableNet calls shockable

input.what: the window ShockableNet scores, after its preprocessing and normalisation (shockable_net.json)
input.run_on: windows at or above ShockableNet's threshold only; the decision layer reads no other

standardise: z = (x - mean(x)) / (sd(x) + 1e-8), sd with divisor n

features.name: lz_complexity
features.how: b = 1 where z > median(z), else 0. Parse b left to right into phrases, each the shortest run from there that is not yet a phrase (the last one may repeat one). c = number of phrases; value c * log2(n) / n

features.name: perm_entropy
features.how: pattern of (z[i], z[i+2], z[i+4]) for every i: the stable argsort, coded as a0 + 3 a1 + 9 a2 (ties keep sample order); Shannon entropy of the pattern frequencies in bits, divided by log2(6)

features.name: spectral_entropy
features.how: Welch spectrum of z: periodic Hann window of 512 samples, overlap 256 (segments 0-511, 256-767, 512-1023; the rest unused), each segment's mean removed, one-sided, segments averaged. Bins f = k * 250 / 512 with 1 <= f <= 15 Hz; q = power / sum of power over those bins; value -sum(q * log2(q + 1e-12)) / log2(number of bins)

features.name: dominant_hz
features.how: f of the bin with the largest power among those (the first if tied)

features.name: concentration
features.how: sum of q over the bins within 0.5 Hz of dominant_hz

features.name: periodicity
features.how: r(k) = sum over i of z[i] * z[i+k], divided by n; the largest r(k) for k = 50 to 149 samples (0.2 to 0.6 s)

features.name: kurtosis
features.how: m4 / m2^2 - 3, central moments of z with divisor n (Fisher, biased)

features.name: skewness
features.how: m3 / m2^1.5, central moments of z with divisor n (biased)

features.name: zero_crossings
features.how: share of the n - 1 steps where sign(z) changes (sign(0) = 0)

features.name: bpm_signal
features.how: on x itself, not z: a = |x - median(x)|, s = 1.4826 * median(a); peaks of a as scipy.signal.find_peaks(a, distance=50, prominence=2 * s) finds them (plateaus at their middle, distance applied before prominence); value 60 / median of the peak-to-peak intervals in seconds. Missing (null) under 3 peaks or when s is 0

pipeline.formula: v = x, or fill where x is missing; z = (v - mean) / scale; p_vt = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coef * z))))

output.name: p_vt
output.meaning: probability of VT rather than VF

decision.rule: each window that confirmed the alert is named VF at p_vt <= 0.1, VT at p_vt >= 0.9, else nothing; the alert is named only when all of them got the same name, else VF/VT
decision.meaning: while naming is off the alert says VF/VT and the name is kept with the ECG recording only (shadow mode)

training.labels: ECG Fragment Database (PhysioNet ecg-fragment-high-risk-label), cardiologists of the Almazov Centre
training.signal: our VFDB copy, each fragment found by its waveform (data/fragments.py); test-split records skipped
training.classifier: mean imputation, standard scaling, logistic regression (C 0.1, balanced classes)

check.method: out of fold, GroupKFold 5 by patient
check.note: the estimate for new patients; the model fitted on everyone has no held-out score of its own
